summary: EDA 2.4 databases can't migrate to 2.6, so when upgrading from 2.4: shut down the EDA 2.4 host, connect with psql as a superuser, run DROP DATABASE automationedacontroller, then run setup and reconnect Automation Decisions to Automation Execution. Not needed for 2.5 to 2.6.
questions: How do I remove the Event-Driven Ansible 2.4 database?
Do I need to delete the EDA database when upgrading from 2.5?
What do I do after the upgrade to reconnect EDA to controller?

answer_card.title: Remove the EDA 2.4 database before upgrading
answer_card.answer_md:
Only for 2.4 → 2.6 (not needed from 2.5).

1. Shut down the EDA 2.4 host.
2. Connect as a superuser: `psql -h <hostname> -U <username>`
3. Run `DROP DATABASE automationedacontroller;`
4. Run the 2.6 `setup.sh`; a new EDA database is created.
5. Reconnect Automation Decisions to Automation Execution so rulebook activations run.
